site.title: X-Piratez
site.footer: X-Piratez — a fan modification of UFO: Enemy Unknown / OpenXcom. Player support site.
site.credit: X-Piratez HD is based on X-Piratez by Dioxine. Dioxine takes no responsibility for this work.
home.title: X-Piratez
home.lead: The mod rewrites the graphics of OpenXcom and touches no mechanics: same numbers, same turn order, a different resolution. Here you will find the launcher, a section per mod, the wiki and the forum.
home.download.about: Version {0}, {1} MB. The launcher fetches the game and keeps it up to date.
home.download.none: The launcher is unavailable right now — the site cannot read the release repository.
home.stats: Launcher installed: {0} · Hours played: {1} · Playing now: {2}
home.stats.note: The statistics are anonymous: the launcher sends a random installation number, no names and no addresses. You can turn it off in the launcher settings.
home.report.title: Found a bug?
home.report.text: Tell us what happened. No account needed: you will get a private link to your ticket.
field.title: Summary
field.name: Display name
new.title: Report a problem
new.guest.hint: No account needed. After sending you get a private link — keep it, replies show up there.
new.category.hint: Artists handle graphics, programmers handle game bugs: the right area gets a faster answer.
new.files.hint: Up to {0} files, up to {1} MB each: images, .log, .txt, .sav saves, .zip archives.
new.consent: I allow attaching logs and saves. They may contain your Windows user name and folder paths; only the developers will see them.
new.done.files_failed: Your ticket has been sent, but some files were refused — check their type and size and add them below.
view.keep_link: Keep the address of this page: it is your private access to the ticket. Do not share it.
view.images_only: Without consent to logs and saves only images can be added.
view.closed: The ticket is closed. If the problem is back, open a new one.
register.title: Register
register.sent: If the address is free, a confirmation link has been sent to it.
register.guest_ok: You do not need an account to report a bug.
register.no_letter: No letter after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or
resend.title: Send the letter again
resend.sent: If the address is registered and not confirmed yet, a new letter has been sent to it. You can ask for the next one in three minutes.
confirm.title: E-mail confirmation
confirm.ok: Your e-mail is confirmed. You can sign in now.
confirm.bad: The link is invalid or has expired.

denied.text: Your account has no access to this page.
denied.need2fa: Team pages open only after a sign-in with two-factor authentication. Turn it on and sign in again.
security.title: Security
security.step1: Install an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
security.step3: Enter the six-digit code from the app.
security.open_app: Open in an app on this device
security.disable.code: Code from the app to turn it off
security.recovery.title: Recovery codes
security.recovery.text: Keep them somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
security.relogin: Two-factor is on. Sign in again, with a code from the app.
admin.search: Number or words from the title
admin.no_categories: You have no areas assigned. Ask a SuperAdmin.
admin.author: Author
admin.take_hint: Moving to “In progress” makes you the assignee, unless the same save names someone else.
admin.internal_note: Internal note — the author will not see it
super.telegram.hint: A new ticket notice goes to its area's route, or to the default route if there is none.
super.telegram.no_token: The bot token is not set (Telegram__BotToken): notices pile up in the queue and are not sent.
super.upstream.hint: Once a day the site looks at X-Piratez on ModDB, OXCE on GitHub and the Russian patch on VK (only with Upstream__VkToken set) and posts to Telegram when something changed. Route: New versions; without it, the default route.

mail.reset.subject: X-Piratez: password reset
mail.test.subject: X-Piratez: site mail check
mail.test.body: The X-Piratez site administrator sent this letter to check the mail setup. No reply is needed.

home.headline: HD graphics for X-Piratez
home.mods.text: A section per mod: what it is, how it differs, where to get it.
home.wiki.text: Items, armour and research, read out of the mod's own rulesets.
home.forum.text: Talk about the game, the mods and the builds.
mods.title: Mods
mods.lead: Every mod gets its own section: description, links, wiki and a board of its own.
mods.author: Author
wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.lead: A reference for the mods. Pages marked «from rulesets» are built from the mod's own files, so their numbers are the numbers in the game.
wiki.empty.mod: This mod has no articles yet.
wiki.derived: Built from the rulesets of version {0} ({1}). An edit here is overwritten by the next import.
wiki.derived.warn: This is a generated page. The next import from the rulesets overwrites whatever you write here.
wiki.other.language: The article does not exist in your language yet - showing the one that does.
wiki.history.none: No edits: the page is in its first version.
wiki.history.hint: A row holds what the page said BEFORE that edit.
wiki.slug.hint: Latin letters, digits and dashes. Leave empty to build it from the title.
wiki.body.hint: Markdown. HTML tags do not work: they show up as text.
wiki.err.title: The title is empty.
wiki.err.slug: An address takes latin letters, digits and dashes only.
wiki.err.taken: An article with that address already exists.
forum.title: Forum
forum.lead: Questions, findings, builds and arguments. Reading needs no account, writing does.
forum.staff.only.hint: Topics here are started by the project team.
forum.locked.hint: The topic is locked: nothing more can be posted in it.
forum.markdown: Markdown. HTML tags do not work: they show up as text.
forum.post.removed: The post was taken down by a moderator.
forum.err.long: The post is longer than allowed.
forum.err.title: The title is empty.
forum.err.title.long: The title is longer than allowed.
devices.title: Launchers
devices.intro: The launcher does not know your password. It shows a short code, you confirm it here, and from then on it works for you with a key of its own. The key can be taken away at any time, on this very page.
devices.confirm.title: Link this launcher?
devices.confirm.text: A launcher is showing the code {0}. If it is yours and the code matches, confirm it.
devices.add.title: Link a launcher
devices.add.hint: The code is in the launcher: Settings, Account. It lives ten minutes.
devices.code_bad: No such code, or it was already used, or it expired. Take a new one in the launcher.
devices.list.title: Linked launchers
devices.name: Launcher
devices.revoke.hint: Once unlinked, the launcher can no longer send in your name; what it already sent stays.
releases.title: Update history
releases.lead: Every update players have received, newest first, each with its "What's new". The launcher shows the same list.
releases.none: The history is not available right now: the release server did not answer.
releases.empty: This update came without a description.
roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.plan.title: What we are doing and what comes next
roadmap.plan.lead: How the art is made, what is done, what is under way and what is planned. This text comes with every update — the same as in the launcher.
roadmap.plan.none: The roadmap text arrives with the next update.
support.title: Support
support.lead: The game is free and will stay free. If you enjoy it, you can thank its authors.
support.hd.title: The HD developers
support.hd.note: For the new graphics, the launcher and this site. By card, SBP, PayPal or cryptocurrency.
friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Friends can be invited to your voice room. Only you see this list.
friends.add.title: Add as a friend: {0}
friends.add.waiting: Your request is waiting for an answer.
friends.request.title: New request
friends.request.who: Name on the site or your friend's link
friends.request.hint: If two people share the name, the site asks for the link: your friend finds it on their friends page.
friends.share.hint: Send it to a friend: with it they can send you a request. The link opens nothing by itself.
friends.outgoing: Your requests waiting for an answer
friends.empty: Nobody yet. Send a request by name or give a friend your link.
friends.remove.hint: A friend removed or blocked loses access to all your rooms at once and leaves them, and you leave theirs.
voice.title: Voice rooms
voice.intro: A room is private: only you and the friends you invited can come in. Talking happens in the launcher; the site shows the room and who may do what.
voice.create.title: Name of the new room
voice.create.hint: Up to {0} rooms. A room stays until you delete it.
voice.open.hint: The launcher asks the site for a pass into the room itself. No launcher?
voice.room.link.hint: The link does not let anyone in: only invited friends can enter.
voice.live.empty: Nobody is in the room now.
voice.live.down: The voice server is not answering right now, so who is inside cannot be shown.
voice.state.no_access.text: There is no such room, or you were not invited to it.
voice.state.account_banned.text: The staff turned voice off for your account. If this is a mistake, write via "Report a problem".
voice.state.banned.text: The owner closed this room to you.
voice.state.invite_revoked.text: The owner withdrew the invitation. You can come in only if they invite you again.
voice.state.not_friends.text: Only a friend of the owner can come into the room.
voice.invite.none: Nobody to invite: every friend is invited already, or there are no friends yet.
voice.members.hint: "Remove" takes the person out at once and withdraws the invitation; "Block" does the same and keeps them out until you lift it. No-talking stays after a reconnect.
voice.close.hint: Closing takes everyone out and lets nobody in until you open it again.
voice.complain.hint: The complaint becomes a ticket you can follow in "My tickets". Talk is never recorded: only the log of entries and actions in the room goes with it.
chan.nodialogues: No conversations yet. '/msg nick text' writes to any player.
chan.none: There are no public channels yet.
chan.empty: It is quiet here. Write the first line.
chan.time: Times are UTC. Lines are kept for 30 days.
chan.who.hint: @ is the owner or staff, + is in voice now. The list is those who looked at the channel in the last minute and a half.
chan.notice.unknown: No such command: {0}. The list of commands: /help
chan.help: Commands: /me text - an action; /topic text - the topic of the channel (owner and staff; /topic - clears it, /topic alone shows it); /msg nick text - a private message; /kick nick, /ban nick, /unban nick, /mute nick, /unmute nick - for the owner and staff; /join #channel, /part, /who, /help.
voice.err.user_not_found: There is no such person on the site.
voice.err.name_ambiguous: Several people have this name: ask your friend for their link.
voice.err.you_blocked: You blocked this person. Lift the block first.
voice.err.already_sent: The request is already waiting for an answer.
voice.err.limit_requests: Too many requests: at most 50 waiting and 30 a day.
voice.err.limit_friends: One of you already has 500 friends.
voice.err.not_friends: Only a friend can be invited.
voice.err.limit_rooms: You have 5 rooms already: delete one you do not need.
voice.err.closed_by_staff: The staff closed this room: only they can open it.
voice.err.owner_only: Only the owner of the room can do this.
voice.err.reason_too_long: The reason is at most 500 characters.
voice.err.banned_in_room: The person is blocked in this room: lift the block first.
voice.err.account_banned: Voice is not allowed for this account.
voice.err.banned: The room is closed to you.
voice.err.voice_unavailable: The voice server is unavailable right now. The decision is saved and will reach it later.
voice.err.too_long: The line is longer than 1000 characters.
voice.err.limit_rate: Too many lines in a minute: 20 at most.
voice.err.moderator_only: Only the owner or the staff can do this.
voice.err.topic_too_long: The topic is at most 300 characters.
super.voice.intro: Turning voice off for an account and closing any room happen only here. A reason is required; everything goes to the log.
super.voice.account: Turn voice off for an account
super.voice.room.hint: A room closed by the staff cannot be opened by its owner.
super.voice.flash.banned: Voice is off for the account; it was taken out of every room.
msg.title: Private messages
msg.intro: One-to-one conversations with friends and other players, text only. You and the other person see them; moderators read them only if one of you files a complaint.
msg.new.who: To: name on the site or profile link
msg.new.hint: Text only, up to {0} characters. Links are not clickable, there are no attachments. You can send a stranger a few messages until they answer.
msg.empty: No conversations yet. Write to a friend or a player above.
msg.complain.hint: A report goes to the moderators with a copy of the latest messages of the conversation; that is the only way they see them.
msg.block.hint: Blocking is site-wide: the person can no longer write to you, send friend requests or invite you to rooms; a friendship, if there was one, ends. You can unblock on the friends page or here.
msg.blocked: You blocked this person: you cannot write to them or receive messages from them.
msg.notice.is_on: E-mail is on: you get one letter when an unread message arrives.
msg.notice.hint: The letter has only the sender's name and a link; the text of the message is not sent. Every letter has an unsubscribe link.
msg.flash.notice_on: E-mail about new messages is on.
msg.flash.notice_off: E-mail about new messages is off.
msg.flash.deleted: Message deleted for you. The other person still has it.
msg.err.too_long: The message is longer than 4000 characters.
msg.err.user_not_found: There is nobody by that name on the site.
msg.err.you_blocked: You blocked this person. Lift the block first.
msg.err.refused: Not sent: this person does not accept messages.
msg.err.limit_rate: Too many messages in a short time. Wait a little.
msg.err.limit_unanswered: The other person has not answered yet. Wait for a reply before writing more.
msg.err.limit_strangers: You can start a conversation with no more than ten strangers a day.
msg.err.no_dialogue: Nothing to report: you have no messages from this person.
msg.err.limit_complaints: You have sent many reports today. Send the rest tomorrow.
msg.complaint.title: Complaint about private messages from {0}
msg.complaint.pointed: The message the complaint is about:
msg.complaint.dialogue: Latest messages of the conversation (► marks the one named in the complaint):
msg.unsub.title: Message e-mail
msg.unsub.done: Done: e-mail about new private messages is off. You can turn it back on on the Messages page.
msg.unsub.bad: The link did not work. You can turn the e-mail off on the Messages page after signing in.

home.team.title: We are recruiting
home.team.text: We need artists, programmers, translators and testers. This is an amateur, non-commercial project: tell us about yourself in a short form.
team.title: We are recruiting
team.lead: X-Piratez HD is a fan-made mod, an amateur and non-commercial project. If you want to help, pick a role and tell us about yourself in the form below: your application goes to the developers.
team.role.artists.text: Draw 2D art and HD frames, polish the graphics.
team.role.programmers.text: Write code: C++ (the game engine) and C# (the site and the launcher).
team.role.translators.text: Translate the strings of the game, the site and the launcher.
team.role.testers.text: Check releases and write bug reports.
team.form.title: Apply
team.field.name: What should we call you
team.contact.hint: An e-mail or a messenger, whatever suits you. The contact is not published: only you (by your private link) and the developers can see it.
team.field.about: About you and what you can do
team.ticket.title: Team application
team.ticket.name: Name
team_role_invalid: Pick a role from the list.
team_name_required: Tell us what to call you.
team_name_too_long: The name is longer than 80 characters.
team_contact_required: Give a contact for a reply.
team_contact_too_long: The contact is longer than 200 characters.
team_about_required: Tell us about yourself and what you can do.
team_about_too_long: The text about you is longer than 2000 characters.
team_link_invalid: The link to your work must start with http:// or https://.
team_link_too_long: The link to your work is longer than 300 characters.
